rca of the issue: Driver accept-offer 403 root cause: after uploading a new document (driving_license) via /app/worker/documents, backend appears to reset users.verification_status back to 'pending' (or the driver was already reset by previous test runs). Backend worker.py accept endpoint checks verification_status==verified. Reproduction: login driver → upload any new doc → try to accept offer → 403 + toast 'حسابك غير موثّق — أكمل رفع وتوثيق مستنداتك لقبول الفرص'. Mitigation: admin sets driver.verification_status='verified' AND all required docs.status='verified'. This is the expected security-first design (any new upload requires re-verification) — not a bug. Only workflow implication is that automated E2E tests should perform verification via admin fixture before hitting the accept path.
